svg.text: Philosophy optional — two traditions in, two applications out
smallest syllabus · highest clarity premium · GS-4 and essay bridges come free
PAPER 1 — METAPHYSICS · EPISTEMOLOGY · LOGIC
Indian: Carvaka (perception only) · Bauddha (kshanika, sunyata)
Jaina anekantavada + syadvada · Nyaya pramanas + syllogism
Vaisesika padarthas · Samkhya dualism · Yoga ashtanga
Mimamsa svatah-pramanya · Advaita maya vs Visistadvaita/Dvaita
Western: Plato-Aristotle → rationalists (D-S-L) → empiricists
(Locke-Berkeley-Hume) → Kant's categories → Hegel's dialectic
Logic: syllogisms · square of opposition · hetvabhasa
style: reconstruction — thesis → arguments → objections → reply → verdict
PAPER 2 — APPLICATIONS
Socio-political: ideologies · sovereignty (Austin vs pluralists)
democracy's grounds · rights generations · punishment trio
gender justice · environmental ethics (anthropo → eco-centred)
Religion: proofs — ontological (Anselm) · cosmological (Aquinas)
teleological (Paley vs Hume) · evil (logical vs evidential)
religious experience (James) · language (Flew vs Wittgenstein)
immortality · pluralism (Hick)
style: fair reconstruction + contemporary hook (rights of rivers, rarest-of-rare)
TWELVE-WEEK FIRST PASS
wk 1-2 heterodox · wk 3-4 Nyaya-Yoga · wk 5 Mimamsa-Vedanta · wk 6-7 Western arc · wk 8 logic · wk 9-10 socio-political · wk 11 religion · wk 12 PYQ + 20 comparison tables
objections to master: Gaunilo & Kant (onto) · Hume (design) · Mackie (evil) · Flew (language)
